description: Measure whether a selected AI model mentions a brand and cites its official domain in real answers. Use when you need repeatable, answer-level evidence with persistent history and deltas for the same brand, domain, queries and model. Returns mentioned, cited, citationCount, model-provided URLs, the complete answer and an accuracy warning. Use aeo_ai_visibility_checker instead for technical website readiness, or local_presence_monitor for Google reviews and local-business signals. Results are specific to the selected model, prompts and run date; they are not a ranking guarantee or verified commercial truth. Auth: Apify API token required in Authorization: Bearer; a separate OpenRouter apiKey is required for real measurements. Rate limits: 60 calls/min/IP on this facade; no pagination. Pricing: $0.05 per run + $0.05 per measured answer + $0.10 per official-domain citation, plus any OpenRouter provider costs. dryRun returns a technical sample without provider calls or event charges.
